mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in the last 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where UNRATE decreases > 0.5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the last 3 months indicates a strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator for broader economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases over the last 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in the last month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases > 1% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% YoY, it signals a restrictive monetary policy environment coupled with weak economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy with weak growth
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 3% and GDPC1 YoY < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in the last month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2%, signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the last 3 months indicates robust consumer demand, which is a leading indicator for economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS increases over the last 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases by more than 0.5% in the last 3 months, it signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases > 0.5% in 3 months.
